quote: Located 10 minutes from the city on a unique and grassy farm in Amsterdam-Noord, Monty’s offers a secure setting where dogs can socialise, play and receive all the care while their owners are at work.
Once we receive your completed Join Us form we will reach out to you for a chat, followed by arranging a trial day
Although we are primarily an outdoor daycare, each area of the daycare has shelter available at all times.
Every dog needs to be up to date on all of their vaccinations and be receiving consistent flea and tick treatment
We share multiple video updates of your dogs day so you'll see their zoomies, new friends and sweet moments!
Drop-off service price remains €25 and is not included in subscriptions
